pr.title: fix: Imported attachment keys end in "null" when no name is set
pr.body:
Attachments from an API import end up with a key like `uploads/<userId>/<uuid>/null`.

`uploadAttachments` reads the name off `alt` for images and `title` for video/attachment. Both come through as `null` when the markup doesn't set one, and `String(null)` is `"null"` — 4 chars, so the `name.length !== 0` check passes and the `node.type.name` fallback never runs. `getKey` then sticks `"null"` on the end of the key.

Fall back to the node type before the `String()`, same shape as `node.attrs.alt || "image"` in Image.tsx. Left the length check in, it still catches `title="   "`.

Only hits importers on the default `shouldUploadAttachmentsPerPage()` — markdown import opts out of this path.

Test checks the last key segment for all three node types, fails on main with `[ 'null', 'null', 'attachment' ]`. It mocks around Sequelize since `uploadAttachments` is private — say the word if you'd rather it sat somewhere else.

Might be related to #13746. That one blames the markdown zip import, which doesn't reach this code, but the key shape is the same.
